tool_args.rationale: All five pilot rows have H ≤ 0.48 and positive y/u_now. Extrapolating to H = 19.9 leaves the sign and magnitude of the response uncertain. The slow-horizon probe directly tests the predicted reversal where the forecast matters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot constrains the early rise but not the slow amplitude and time constant well enough to predict the response at H = 19.9.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit sink-coupled adaptation or harmonic oscillation now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: With s_grad fixed at zero, the sink coefficient is unidentifiable. The short positive window also does not establish periodicity.
Finer time resolution does not directly test whether the gain reverses near the forecast horizon.
